name: libxkbcommon
description: Keymap compiler and support library implementing the XKB (X Keyboard Extension) specification, used to translate raw key events into keysyms/characters. The standard keyboard-handling library on Wayland; also provides Compose/dead-key handling and a keyboard-layout registry.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
